Name: PflegegradDE
Title: PflegegradDE ValueSet
Description: Codes zur genaueren Differenzierung des Pflegegrads.

Name: BundleType
Title: BundleType
Description: Indicates the purpose of a bundle - how it is intended to be used.

Name: CommonTags
Title: Common Tags
Description: Common Tag Codes defined by FHIR project

Name: HTTPVerb
Title: HTTPVerb
Description: HTTP verbs (in the HTTP command line). See [HTTP rfc](https://tools.ietf.org/html/rfc7231) for details.

Name: QuestionnaireItemType
Title: QuestionnaireItemType
Description: Distinguishes groups from questions and display text and indicates data type for questions.

Name: Jurisdiction ValueSet
Title: Jurisdiction
Description: This value set defines a base set of codes for country, country subdivision and region    for indicating where a resource is intended to be used.             Note: The codes for countries and country subdivisions are taken from    [ISO 3166](https://www.iso.org/iso-3166-country-codes.html)    while the codes for "supra-national" regions are from    [UN Standard country or area codes for statistical use (M49)](http://unstats.un.org/unsd/methods/m49/m49.htm).

Name: CommonLanguages
Title: Common Languages
Description: This value set includes common codes from BCP-47 (http://tools.ietf.org/html/bcp47)

Name: PublicationStatus
Title: PublicationStatus
Description: The lifecycle status of an artifact.

Name: QuestionnaireAnswerCodes
Title: Questionnaire Answer Codes
Description: Example list of codes for answers to questions. (Not complete or necessarily appropriate.)

Name: QuestionnaireResponseStatus
Title: QuestionnaireResponseStatus
Description: Lifecycle status of the questionnaire response.

Name: EnableWhenBehavior
Title: EnableWhenBehavior
Description: Controls how multiple enableWhen values are interpreted -  whether all or any must be true.

Name: QuestionnaireItemOperator
Title: QuestionnaireItemOperator
Description: The criteria by which a question is enabled.

Name: QuestionnaireQuestionCodes
Title: Questionnaire Question Codes
Description: Example list of codes for questions and groups of questions. (Not necessarily complete or appropriate.)

Name: ResourceType
Title: ResourceType
Description: One of the resource types defined as part of this version of FHIR.

Name: SearchEntryMode
Title: SearchEntryMode
Description: Why an entry is in the result set - whether it's included as a match or because of an _include requirement, or to convey information or warning information about the search process.

Name: All Security Labels
Title: SecurityLabels
Description: A single value set for all security labels defined by FHIR.

Name: ConformanceExpectation
Title: ConformanceExpectation
Description: Indicates the degree of adherence to a specified behavior or capability expected for a system to be deemed conformant with a specification.

Name: ISiKTerminPriority
Description: Enthaelt alle SNOMED Codes, die eine valide Priorität für den ISiKTermin sind
